q: How does a banquet hall work out the carbon footprint of a wedding?
title: Banquet hall wedding carbon footprint
short: Read the electricity and generator diesel for the event, the LPG used in the kitchen and the food bought, then divide by guests. Catering and generators usually lead. Guest travel can be estimated separately if the couple asks for it.
audience: Banquet halls, caterers and event planners

ul: Meter reading before and after the event.
LPG cylinders used in the kitchen.

p: Divide by confirmed headcount. Food waste weighed after the event adds a useful number for reducing next time.

example.title: One evening
lines: Diesel 120 L x 2.68 = 322 kg; LPG 6 x 19 kg x 2.98 = 340 kg
Grid 900 kWh x 0.710 = 639 kg; total 1,301 kg for 500 guests = 2.6 kg each
